book.name: LOMU
book.title: Lomu wewenasida luhuwa maya Polokaho je biye

content: Aebalahamukaho lihimate minametibo minatune loko lo omutibo ga.
Yamuya lemo Juda wewenalikaya latate Aebalahamukahoya nena nesama le soto molaibo ne loko letune.

Emokahoya oko moloko ibo nesauya wehe lokogo oko moloko ibokumuya Omailimo lihimala alo suwokaibo ne loko liboto minatidanako, Aebalahamuya eimola upala leko yowitibo neboya, Omailimo sa-loko lamiyoko nenako, omudalaloya upala leko yowitibo anuwa minamiye.
Sa-iyoko, emokumuya monoka bukuguya sa-liki luhuwa ji-minabo ne:

content.text: Aebalahamuya Omaimidanamuya elewole oko elibokumuya lihimala suwokaibo ne loko loetaiye.

content: Ito wewena mako yowanu litibototiya meinawa litiboya aha noliye liki litahe. O'e, sakoya minamiye, yowanu libomidana meinawa maya noliye liki litae.

Ayamidana oko wewena mako Omaimidana omudaloya wehe loko minatuwe loko lalo nesa lolo o-loko wetiboya Omailimo elewole epa mutiwa mitiboya ahamuye loko lamoko yamidana meinawa noliye loko letudawoya, elewole lepa mutiwa lekaka monawa sako minamiye. Wehe loko emesalo moloko lepa mutiwa letudawo nesa minamiye. Muki lahelamabo wewenasida lihimanipo hulobetokaka we Jisesida elewole iki eli mitabo wewena maya Omailimoya lihimanipo suwibo wewenae loko lobetakolaiye.
Uliki we Dewitiya Omailimo asako wewena mako saina lalo lolo i-liki witabokumuya elamoko lihimatipo suwokaiye loko lobetaibo wesiya elowa jebo wewenasidamuya sa-loko luhuwa jenebo ne:

content.text: Lihimatipo le hulobetaibokumu ito lahelamibo nesa le olutobetaibokumuya elikiki elowa jikaka niae.
Wewena malokaya Omailimo lihimanipo molobetamibo wewenasiya elowa jikilae.

content: Elowa jekaka nesaya lemo Omaimidana anela lupalo nebo Juda wewenalogo minamiye. Hetoka wewenaloki ito muki wewenasidaki nebogo ne. Aebalahamudamuya sa-loko elekaka noune: Elewole oko eliyoko Omailimo lihimaka suwokaiye we loko loetaiboya,
nena yupeka sa-loko loetaibo ne. Upaloya Omaimidana anelakiya neyoko nehe, ito minamiyoko ne. Minamiyoko sa-loko loetaibo ne.

Emoya upaloya Omaimidana anela minamiyoko minoko Omaidamuya elewole oko elibolawaya Omailimo mudakoko lihimala suwoetibomidana monawala maya ilipe suwokoko alikaya anela maya upalo moloetaiye. Aebalahamumamo sakoko dupalo Omaimidana anela minamibo wewenasiya Omaimidanamu elewole oko eludawo wewenasida ahote lolo onebo ne. Sakoya muki wewenasiya Omaimidanamu elewole iki elitabo wewenasida ahonipo lolo onebo ne. Sakoya muki wewenasidamuya lihimanipo suwibo wewena lolo iki minatae loko elene.

Sa-oneboya, Omai anelaki minudawo wewena ahotekiya ne. Omaimidana anelaki minudawomu minamiye. Elewole oko elekaka anuwa maya latate Aebalahamukahoya api oko wileletaibo anugu maya woko elewole udawokumuye loko anelaki minudawo wewena ahoteya lolo one. 3 Jen 15:6; Gal 3:6 7-8 Sam 32:1-2 11 Jen 17:10-11
Elewole oko eludawokumuye loko Omailimo lo mololetaibo nesa lekaka noune.

Omailimoya Aebalahamuda owopilalesiya muki mikaya litae loko lo molobetaiboya, Omailimo lo hukaibo ga emesalo molabokumuye loko minamiye. Omaimidanamu elewole oko elibomuya lihimaka alo suwokaiye loko loetaiye.

Muki mika litae loko lo molobetaiboya Omaimidana gala emesala moliki eli lebo wewenasida nesanipo le lolo etidanako, elewole iki elebo nesa maya woko aha nesa lolo etine, ito lo molobetaibo ga maya woko aha nesa lolo etine.

Lo hukaibo ga ele letudawo anulo wetudawoya ito aya gaya ele lametudawoya auha loko oijo kohalelakolaiye. Lo hukoko gaya lemotokaya minamibo netidanako, aya gaya ele hulokaka nesa minametibo minatine.

Sa-onenako, Omailimoya saina lo mololibetonebo nesa maya elewole oko eludawomuye loko soto pekolaiye. Yaya nena nesamuye. Emoya nasahili oletokaka ibo we loko, ito Aebalahamuda awolale yuha lemotoka lo hukoko libo ga maya woko ulalo litiye loko he elowo oletaiye. Lo hukaibo ga emesalo moliki eli lebo wewenasidagoya minamiye. Aebalahamuya Omaimidana omudaloya lemo muki latateya nedanaki, elewole oko eletudawo anuwa wileletaiboya aito anugu wokaka noudawo wewena lemo muki minune.
Sa-nouniyoko, Omailimoya Aebalahamuda sa-loko lo moloetaibo ga mako monoka bukuguya luhuwa ji-minabo ne:

content.text: Emodaya nemokahoya muki numuto namato wewenasida ahonipo minatane loko lolo noetoe.

content: Ito Aebalahamukaho elewole oko elibomidana lemoya asako Omaimuya elewole oko elekoko emo awola lolo okune. Omailimoya heletudawokutiya lilime sinatuwe loko aha lilime sinatibo ne. Ito saina owaha soto pamibo nesahenaya emo letiboto aha soto pitibo wemidana gala maya noloe.

Saina mako alika lekoloe loko ubolo minoko elowa jitibo monawa minamiyoko, aya nesalogo ata keke oko muki yupeka ata molamiyoko, Omailimo lo mibo galoya muki wewenasida latanipo lolo etibokumu Omailimoya sa-loko lo miye:

content.text: Awopilakaleya wavu-liki sonohikidana alikaya soto piki minakilae.

content: Loko lo mekaiyoko, meleke 100 minoko upala maya isulupa jeko iloho molaiyoko, menala Selamakiya asako upala isulupa jeko oluho etatibo onawa maya alo hapa wokaiboya, Omailimoya lo mibo ga maya ata molamiyoko elewole oko ata keko nebo ne.
Ito Omailimo lo mibo ga maya woko aha nesa lolo amibo ne. Aya galo maya elewole oko eleko abuha moloko Omaimidanamuya sa-loko elibo nesa makokolimoya yoweko elibo ne.
Omailimo saina mako lolo etuwe loko libo ga maya nenako, aya nesa maya lolo etibo neyo lokoko Omaimidana uliwa maya le sawa jeko loko nebo ne.
Sa-onebo nenako, Aebalahamukaho elewole oko elibokumuya monoka bukuguya sa-liki luhuwa ji-minabo ne:

content.text: Omailimo muda-elaibo maya lihimala suwibo ne

content: liki luhuwa ji-minabo ne.
Omailimoya lihimala suwibo ne loko liboya, Aebalahamudamugo loko luhuwa jamibo ne.
Lemo muki wewenamuya luhuwa jiye. We napate Jisesi maya helenebokuti ilime sinaibo wemidanamuya elewole oko elekuniyoko asako lihimate alo suwokaiye loko loletakolaiye.

Jisesida maya lemo lihimatemuye liki ilimi helikaka anulo molae. Sa-ikayoko, lihimanipo suwikadeko minatae loko elekoko Omailimoya aku ilime sinaiye. 13 Jen 17:4-6; Jen 22:17-18; Gal 3:29 14 Gal 3:18 16 Gal 3:7 17 Jen 17:5 18 Jen 15:5 19 Jen 17:17 25 Aes 53:4-5
